phone.chooseCountry: Choose a country or enter the number with + and its country code.
phone.review: Check the number before calling or messaging. Your original entry is preserved.
phone.extension: This number has an extension. Review the recipient before calling or messaging.
phone.importHint: Used only for numbers without an international prefix. Original CSV values are preserved.

money.help: Changes the display of IRR amounts only. Saved amounts and other currencies stay the same.
money.entryUnit: Enter amounts in <unit>{currency}</unit>. Display settings do not change this unit.

dates.timeZone: Time zone for dates without an offset
dates.hint: Use YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY/MM/DD or DD.MM.YYYY. ISO timestamps with an explicit UTC offset always use the Gregorian calendar. Date-only values keep their calendar day.
dates.ambiguous: This clock time occurs twice. Use a Gregorian ISO timestamp with an explicit UTC offset to choose the correct occurrence.
dates.nonexistent: This clock time does not exist in the selected time zone. Check the time in the source file.
